about: Free control of the refusal classifier (persona_battery.is_refusal). Natural short answers to a question about a detail that nobody wrote down, in a domain voice: refusals (what the classifier must call a refusal) and improvisations (concrete invented details, which it must not). refusals/improvisations: the development bank, written while the patterns were drafted. dev2: written after a first measurement of the patterns on it (recall 0.31 on the refusals), then used to generalise them. held_out: written after the patterns were frozen again, in different phrasings, never used to change a pattern. All synthetic; nothing here comes from a card.
